Programa Paran Seguro

description.narrative: El objetivo general del Programa es contribuir a reducir los ndices de crmenes violentos en las ciudades de Curitiba, Regin Metropolitana (RM), eje Londrina-Maring y la regin fronteriza paranaense. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) aumentar la eficacia de la Polica Civil (PC) y Polica Militar (PM) paranaense en el control y prevencin de la criminalidad; y (ii) reducir la incidencia delictiva de los jvenes de 15 a 24 aos en condiciones de alta vulnerabilidad y la reincidencia de la poblacin joven en conflicto con la ley.

The overall objective of the program is to reduce violent crime rates in the cities of Curitiba Metropolitan Region (RM), Londrina-Maring axis and Paran border region. The specific objectives are: (i) increase the effectiveness of the Civil Police (PC) and Military Police (MP) in the control and prevention of crime, and (ii) reduce the crime rate of young people aged 15 to 24 under conditions of high vulnerability and recidivism of young people in conflict with the law.
